The *Kusalattika, Rūpāvacaraduka* (Patthana 22.10) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In conformity with the systematic matrix of the collection, this section examines conditional relations by combining the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) with the dyad pertaining to the form sphere (*rūpāvacaraduka*) [SuttaCentral].
